plot: Donald is shoveling the snow off his walk; Chip 'n' Dale are shoveling their branch. Donald tricks them into shoveling his walk. Angered, they sneak into his house, where he's getting ready...

title: Nature's Half Acre
plot: The variety of wildlife in a meadow - particularly insects and flowers - is observed over the course of a year, through the use of microphotography and time-lapse photography.
writer: Winston Hibler (script), Ted Sears (script), James Algar (script)

title: Out of Scale
plot: Donald Duck has a model train and town laid out in his yard. He decides to move a live tree that doesn't match the model scale, not realizing it is home to chipmunks Chip and Dale. They in turn move into one of the miniature houses.
actors: Dessie Flynn, James MacDonald, Clarence Nash
